proposals.evidence: Full phulla explicitly gives regional phul/phūl flower, Oriya phula, West Pahari fūl and Kotgarhi phulṛu. These support the selected simple phul/pul/fricative forms and western phulḍ- extensions through the documented rhotic extension. Source aspiration, fricatives, lateral quality, vowels and endings remain intact; the exact local extension and cross-IA transmission are qualified. This is the flower family, not phala fruit; nasal and unexplained k-initial forms remain separate. Exact response: ɸəl.
